Recent Highlights • Announced a $5 million strategic equity investment by Navitas Semiconductor, further strengthening the companies' partnership to develop differentiated next-generation power semiconductor solutions. • Launched 15 new sixth-generation E6 Super-Junction MOSFETs targeting TVs, notebook adapters, PC power supplies and other consumer and industrial power applications. • Continued execution of its new-generation power semiconductor roadmap, expanding its portfolio of products to strengthen competitiveness, increase profitability, and address new market opportunities. SEOUL, South Korea, Nov. 4, 2026 – Magnachip Semiconductor Corporation (NYSE: MX) (“Magnachip” or the “Company”) today announced financial results for the third quarter 2026. “While headwinds to our near-term financial performance remain, I am encouraged by the progress we are making in transforming Magnachip,” said Chae Lee, Chief Executive Officer of Magnachip. “We have significantly accelerated new-generation product development, established a clear roadmap for differentiated solutions, and strengthened our strategic partnership with Navitas Semiconductor. Our objective is to move beyond competing primarily on price to delivering innovative power semiconductor solutions that address increasingly complex customer requirements. Although this transformation will take time, I believe we are building the foundation for stronger competitive positioning, sustainable growth and improved profitability.” Q3 2026 Financial Highlights In thousands of U.S. dollars, except per-share data GAAP Q3 2026 Q2 2026 Q/Q change (1) Q3 2025 Y/Y change (1) Net Sales 43,978 44,704 −1.6% 45,946 −4.3% Power Analog Solutions 39,636 40,574 −2.3% 41,548 −4.6% Power IC 4,342 4,130 +5.1% 4,398 −1.3% Gross Profit Margin 14.0% 19.3% −5.3 pp 18.6% −4.6 pp Power Analog Solutions 10.7% 17.2% −6.5 pp 16.0% −5.3 pp Power IC 45.0% 40.9% +4.1 pp 43.2% +1.8 pp Operating Loss (12,880) (9,976) −29.1% (11,538) −11.6% Loss from Continuing Operations (13,286) (7,601) −74.8% (10,609) −25.2% Basic Loss per Common Share (0.36) (0.21) −71.4% (0.29) −24.1% Diluted Loss per Common Share (0.36) (0.21) −71.4% (0.29) −24.1% In thousands of U.S. dollars, except per-share data Non-GAAP (2) Q3 2026 Q2 2026 Q/Q change (1) Q3 2025 Y/Y change (1) Adjusted Operating Loss (8,593) (6,976) − 23.2% (7,421) − 15.8% Adjusted EBITDA (3,496) (4,219) +17.1% (3,964) +11.8% Adjusted Loss (10,732) (4,901) −119.0% (390) NM Adjusted Loss per Common Share—Diluted (0.29) (0.13) −123.1% (0.01) NM NM = Not Meaningful. However, such non-GAAP financial measures have limitations and should not be considered as a substitute for net loss or as a better indicator of our operating performance than measures that are presented in accordance with GAAP. Reconciliations of non-GAAP financial measures to their most directly comparable GAAP measures are included in this press release. Q4 2026 Financial Guidance While actual results may vary, Magnachip currently expects the following: • Consolidated revenue from continuing operations (which includes Power Analog Solutions and Power IC businesses) to be in the range of $41.0 million to $45.0 million reflecting the typical seasonal softness in the fourth quarter. At the midpoint, this represents a decrease of 2.2% sequentially and an increase of 6.0% year-over-year, compared with $44.0 million in Q3 2026 and $40.6 million in Q4 2025. • Consolidated gross profit margin from continuing operations to be in the range of 10% to 12%, compared with 14.0% in Q3 2026 and 9.3% in Q4 2025. The sequential decline is primarily due to lower utilization resulting from a power shutdown in the fab due to a substation upgrade and appreciation of Korean Won. “Third quarter revenue was within our guidance range, although gross profit margin was below our expectations, primarily due to unfavorable foreign exchange movements,” said Shinyoung Park, Chief Financial Officer of Magnachip. “Looking at next quarter, despite headwinds on legacy products, foreign exchange volatility and the impact of the recently completed electrical substation upgrade, we remain focused on managing costs and maintaining the financial flexibility necessary to support our strategic transformation. With approximately $87 million in cash at quarter-end, we believe we are well-positioned to continue investing selectively in the technologies and products that will drive our long-term competitiveness.” Q3 2026 Earnings Conference Call Magnachip will host a corresponding conference call at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026, to discuss its financial results. About Magnachip Semiconductor Magnachip is a designer and manufacturer of analog and mixed-signal power semiconductor platform solutions for various applications, including industrial, automotive, communication, consumer and computing. The Company provides a broad range of standard products to customers worldwide. Magnachip, with about 45 years of operating history, owns a substantial number of registered patents and pending applications, and has extensive engineering, design and manufacturing process expertise. For more information, please visit www.magnachip.com .
